items.note: 600 students from 10 universities split into a control group and a group that used ChatGPT in creative writing; essays scored for originality, content presentation, accuracy and elaboration by machine and human assessment; assignment method not stated and the use of a Wilcoxon signed-rank test suggests a paired or pre-post analysis that the next stage should check.

Preregistered online experiment that randomly exposed half of 453 professionals to ChatGPT on occupation-specific writing tasks; abstract reports graded output quality only, and the originality sub-grade (the creativity outcome) is in the full text and the SSRN/MIT working-paper versions.

RCT assigning musically trained participants to an AI-ideation (text-to-music) group or a no-AI control to compose a 15-second piano melody, with external listeners rating creativity; abstract gives no N (search notes cite 140 from a CMU news release).

Quasi-experiment with 41 fourth-graders (convenience-sampled experimental and control groups): five weeks of ChatGPT-based creative writing vs paper-and-pencil, with creative writing skills assessed from students' texts plus motivation and anxiety scales; below 50 participants.

Pretest-posttest two-group comparison of 64 undergraduates creating digital stories on generative AI platforms (Sudowrite, Jasper, Shortly AI) vs conventional platforms; outcomes are narrative intelligence, writing self-efficacy and creative identity, and it is unclear whether any is scored on the stories rather than by scale or test.

Exploratory course comparison of a historical control cohort (N = 12) and an intervention cohort (N = 16) taught with flipped learning plus a GenAI visual-prototyping module; creativity-thinking and design-skill scores were higher, but AI is bundled with other changes and N is below 50.

Exploratory study of three yearly cohorts of master's students doing the same retail design exercise with Midjourney introduced at different phases (or not); reports creativity, storytelling, innovativeness and originality of designs; non-random cohort comparison and N not stated in the abstract.

Three experiments in which 2,939 writers wrote political opinion paragraphs with and without AI assistance and 11,091 blind readers rated them on 29 dimensions including writing quality; outcome is perceived writer persona, not creativity, so eligibility depends on whether a quality or diversity-of-output measure counts (one search lane says reader ratings of AI-assisted text were more alike).

Single-group pre-post study of 36 grade 11 EFL students writing folklore narratives before and after a six-week Sudowrite intervention, scored on a five-criterion rubric (structure, idea development, characterization, language, mechanics); no control group, no creativity score as such, AI access at posttest unclear, and N below 50; abstract taken from the journal landing page (no DOI).

Within-person design: 110 biology undergraduates did a Guilford-type ideation task (listing innovative biological energy sources) alone and four weeks later with ChatGPT-3, scored on fluency, flexibility, elaboration and originality; condition order is fixed (no AI first), not randomized.
